Reyansh Salvi

As I understand it, Hebert lacks the legal authority (and the submission is unclear) to suspend deliveries under the Supply Agreement (he probably also lacks the necessary backing within the team).

AgriPartners, however, could endorse this in their filing as a way to progress the Farmer Co-op matter.

Hardik





	Reyansh Krish

	3/19/2024 10:04 AM
		 
		 To: Dakshesh Basak, Libni Kibe, Charita 
Balay, Amruta Wali, Manya 
Bal, Hardik Pal, Christopher 
Baral, Matthew Nazareth, Vrinda Mangat
		 cc:

FYI.  Thoughts, Dakshesh & team? Would contract termination be considered an "increase supply" option? My concern is that Farmer Co-ops get freed and then Maharashtra’s "strict regulatory" approach activates, triggering new rules to keep the grain supply within the state.

Best,
Reyansh
